text.2:225: Allah will not take you to task for that which is unintentional in your oaths. But He will take you to task for that which your hearts have garnered. Allah is Forgiving, Clement.
text.5:89: Allah will not take you to task for that which is unintentional in your oaths, but He will take you to task for the oaths which ye swear in earnest. The expiation thereof is the feeding of ten of the needy with the average of that wherewith ye feed your own folk, or the clothing of them, or the liberation of a slave, and for him who findeth not (the wherewithal to do so) then a three days' fast. This is the expiation of your oaths when ye have sworn; and keep your oaths. Thus Allah expoundeth unto you His revelations in order that ye may give thanks.
text.19:62: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.
text.25:72: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity.
text.28:55: And when they hear vanity they withdraw from it and say: Unto us our works and unto you your works. Peace be unto you! We desire not the ignorant.
text.52:23: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.
text.56:25: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination
text.78:35: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -
